page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a dedication heading at top; no margin notes. Page number top right (a mark, possibly "3" in old hand, treated as handwriting/omitted). Signature "A 2" at foot centre-left, catchword "sio-" at right below last line.

main_text.head: Viro illustri,
D. FRANCISCO AB AERSSEN, EQVITI AVRATO, TOPARCHÆ SOMMELSDYCKENSI, & PLATENSI, STATUS CONSILIARIO, &c. ACADEMIÆ CURATORI, S. P.
main_text.p: VANQVAM variæ extent nobilissimæ huius artis institutiones, nullæ tamen, aut paucæ, quod pollicentur, efficiunt. Nam ut omittam quarundam fastidiosam prolixitatem, nonnullæ totæ sunt in controversiis scientiæ naturalis dissolvendis, quas fortasse aliunde hauriri satius esset.
